description: Concepts the lexicon does not cover yet, kept as a human review queue. Nothing here is part of the language until a human accepts it and it lands in fonoran-compounds.json or fonoran-approved-roots.json.
provenance: Every record carries source "vocab_survey": two runs of a model-driven survey that asked what a small lexicon was missing, on 2026-07-04 and 2026-07-07. That pipeline has been deleted. The wording of each rationale and gloss is therefore model-written English and has not been reviewed. The concept list is worth keeping as a to-do list; the prose in it carries no authority.
